title: Tariff Clause: Amount of the Same-Day Confirmed Change Fee
content:
**Tariff clause — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The same-day change fee is the fare brand's same-day confirmed change fee, charged once for each same-day confirmed exchange. The amount is taken from the exchange terms of the ticket's fare brand and is rounded to the cent.

## Terms used in this clause

- **The exchange charged.** The fee is set for the latest same-day confirmed exchange recorded on the ticket.
- **The segment being changed.** The segment moved by that exchange is the ticket's first unflown segment: the segment whose number is one more than the number of coupons already flown on the ticket.
- **The fare brand's same-day confirmed change fee.** The figure the fare brand's exchange terms give for a same-day confirmed change, per passenger per direction.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Input | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A same-day confirmed exchange recorded on the ticket | One fee for that exchange | The fare brand's same-day confirmed change fee, rounded to the cent |
| A second same-day confirmed exchange on the same ticket | A fee of its own | Charged once for that exchange as well |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A ticket has flown no coupon, so its first unflown segment is segment 1. Its latest same-day confirmed exchange moved that segment to a later flight on the same date. If the fare brand's same-day confirmed change fee were 60 dollars, the same-day change fee for that exchange would be 60.00 dollars.

## Basis Q&A

**Is the fee charged per exchange or per ticket?** Once for each same-day confirmed exchange.

**To what precision is the fee stated?** To the cent.
